---
name: "Scoped task"
about: "Plan one reviewable implementation, research, design, or documentation task."
title: "[Task] "
---

<!-- Start with GETTING_STARTED.md and commons/BACKLOG.md on the relevant branch.
Use public or synthetic examples; omit sensitive personal data and secrets. -->

## Outcome and who it helps

What should someone be able to do? Include a backlog ID if applicable.

## Scope and exclusions

What is the smallest useful change? What is explicitly deferred?

## Dependencies and overlap

Link related issues, active PRs, proposed ADRs, and the intended base branch.
Identify anything blocked or still requiring a decision.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given ..., when ..., then ... (observable behavior or deliverable)

## Worldwide interoperability and accessibility

Describe languages/scripts, time zones, geographic assumptions, keyboard access,
and data portability affected. Say why an item is not applicable if needed.

## Privacy and sourcing

List data collected or exposed, source provenance and reuse terms, uncertainty,
and any relevant access or correction concerns. Never paste private evidence.

## Validation

How will a reviewer reproduce the result? Which checks and fixtures are needed?
